title: Meth Dealer Disarmed by Picnic Table During Police Chase
description:
Meth Dealer Disarmed by Picnic Table during Police Chase

On 2/5/20, a La Crosse, WI Police Officer initiated a traffic stop on a vehicle at which, James R. Dean, exited the passenger side, and a short foot pursuit ensued. As he was making his escape, he did not see a picnic table and collided with it. During his time of flight, a 9mm loaded handgun was flying in the air and falling on the ground. As a result, officers discovered 0.5 pounds of methamphetamine which has a street value of $8000. 

James was charged with the following: 
- Possession of Methamphetamine with Intent to Deliver
- Battery to Law Enforcement
- Felon in Possession of a Firearm
- Carrying a Concealed Knife
- Resisting/Obstructing an Officer
- Possession of Drug Paraphernalia
- Probation Violation
- Possession of THC
- Possession of Narcotic Drugs

Code Blue Cam provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams to report, inform, and educate viewers. The videos on this channel have been obtained through Public Records Requests.

🛑 The featured content is NOT intended to be violent or glorify violence in any way. We are sharing the footage STRICTLY for the purposes of news reporting and educating. 🛑
